reason: The AC ten-run baseline ranges from 1153.5 to 1685.6 GFLOP/s, and supplied wrapper trials show substantial variation without repeatable promotion. No proposal has measured evidence of a gain. I ranked the TB descriptor ideas first because they target a generated B-pack path and require one timed 1 MiB transpose; n512_fast_path and assembly_audit describe the same mapping, so treat them as aliases and test at most once. panel_packing is a distinct TB layout with the same conversion cost and additional uncertainty. The 320-byte scratch stride is measurable but risks larger stack use and relies on unknown cache indexing. The store-order change has lower layout risk but no evidence that it improves locality. The remaining transpose ideas add conversion or implementation complexity; transpose_fusion lacks a specified legal SME instruction path, while TA and TT require two timed input transposes. Any result must use the frozen repeated paired controls and promotion gates; these ranks do not establish cache causality or expected speedups.
